materials.name: Stainless Steel 304 or 316L

faq.title: Technical & Engineering Answers
faq.desc: All key information structured about our materials, local regulations in Miami-Dade and delivery processes.

items.q: Does Dario's comply with the Florida Building Code (FBC) for hurricanes?
items.a: Yes. Darioscustom strictly complies with the Florida Building Code (FBC). We design and weld our security grilles, gates, and railings following ASCE 7 wind load requirements, achieving wind resistance capacities of up to 175 mph for hurricane-prone zones.

items.q: What are the differences between traditional blacksmith paint and Powder Coating?
items.a: Powder Coating is a dry finishing process thermoset at 400°F that forms a protective shield. Unlike traditional paint that peels under the Miami sun, Powder Coating resists impacts, UV rays, and extreme moisture without rusting the base metal.

items.q: What service areas do you cover in South Florida?
items.a: Our service areas in South Florida include Miami, Coral Gables, Doral, Brickell, Pinecrest, Key Biscayne, South Miami, and Kendall. We cover the entire Miami-Dade County area for measurement, delivery, and installation of custom architectural ironwork.

items.q: What kind of maintenance do your metal gates and grilles require?
items.a: The maintenance of our metal gates and grilles consists of washing the structures every 3 to 6 months with clean water and mild non-abrasive soap. Thanks to our galvanized finish and powder coating, this simple process easily removes dust and sea salt.

items.q: What is the process to request a technical quote for my residence or business?
items.a: The process to request a technical quote consists of contacting us via web or WhatsApp with preliminary measurements and reference photos. We first provide an accurate economic proposal and then schedule an on-site visit to verify exact dimensions at your property.
